'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****At least 85 [[Palestinians]] are killed by [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] attacks in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/24/live-israel-kills-dozens-of-palestinians-in-attacks-on-war-devastated-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***Twenty-two [[Israelis]] are injured, including two seriously, after a [[Drone warfare|drone]] launched by the [[Yemen]]-based [[Houthis]] strikes [[Eilat]] in [[Southern District (Israel)|southern Israel]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/09/24/world/yemen-drone-attack-eilat-intl-latam (CNN)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[Afghanistan–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
***Thirteen [[Pakistani Taliban]] fighters are killed after a raid by [[Pakistan Armed Forces|security forces]] at a hideout in [[Dera Ismail Khan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], near the [[Durand Line]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-security-raid-killed-pakistani-taliban-northwest-a75ecb146d5ecc406e5c42deaaa852fb (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Ragasa]]
***[[Philippines|Filipino]] authorities conclude a [[search and rescue]] operation for the 13-man crew of fishing boat ''FB Jobhenz'', which [[Capsizing|capsized]] in [[Santa Ana, Cagayan]], Philippines, on Monday. Six crew members are rescued, with the remaining seven confirmed to have died. [https://mb.com.ph/2025/09/24/7-dead-from-capsized-fishing-boat (''Manila Bulletin'')]
***The [[Hong Kong Observatory]] issues its highest [[Hong Kong tropical cyclone warning signals|typhoon warning]], Signal No. 10, in the morning before downgrading it to Signal No. 8 at 4 pm. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/24/super-typhoon-ragasa-kills-14-in-taiwan (Al Jazeera)] [https://macaonews.org/news/city/super-typhoon-ragasa-macau-impact/ (Macao News)]
*A section of road collapses into an estimated {{cvt|50|m|ft|abbr=on}}-deep [[sinkhole]] in front of [[Vajira Hospital]] in [[Bangkok]], [[Thailand]], prompting road closures and [[emergency evacuation|evacuations]] of nearby buildings. No injuries and deaths are reported. [https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/health-environment/article/3326618/massive-sinkhole-swallows-cars-pedestrian-crossing-near-bangkok-hospital (''South China Morning Post'')] [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/road-collapses-near-bangkoks-chao-phraya-river-no-injuries-reported-so-far (''The Straits Times'')]
*All 23 [[Mineral industry of Colombia|miners]] trapped for two days in a [[mining accident|collapsed]] [[Gold mining|gold]] [[mine shaft]] in [[Segovia, Antioquia|Segovia]], [[Antioquia Department|Antioquia]], [[Colombia]], are rescued alive after receiving food, water, and oxygen through pipelines during the operation. [https://gbcode.rthk.hk/TuniS/news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1824590-20250925.htm?spTabChangeable=0 (AFP via RTHK)]
*[[Costa Rica]] closes its [[airspace]] for at least five hours after a [[power outage]] disables [[radar]] systems and disrupts hundreds of flights, before reopening after systems were restored. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/costa-rica-closes-airspace-temporarily-suspends-flights-after-power-malfunction-2025-09-24/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2025 Allenby Bridge shooting]], [[Israel–Jordan relations]]
**[[Israel]] indefinitely closes the [[Allenby Bridge]] between [[Jordan]] and the [[West Bank]] days after reopening it following a shooting that killed two [[Israel Defence Forces|Israeli soldiers]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-close-allenby-crossing-wednesday-until-further-notice-palestinian-border-2025-09-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Africa–United States relations]]
**[[Lesotho|Lesotho's]] [[commerce minister]] announces the [[United States]]'s plan to extend the [[African Growth and Opportunity Act]] by one year following negotiations in [[Washington, D.C.]] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/lesotho-says-us-plans-extend-africa-trade-deal-by-year-2025-09-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Belarus–Poland relations]]
**[[Poland]] reopens [[Belarus–Poland border|its border with Belarus]] after closing them during [[Russia]]-led [[Zapad 2025|military exercises]], citing reduced security risks and economic considerations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/poland-reopen-border-crossings-with-belarus-pm-says-2025-09-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[France–United Kingdom relations]], [[English Channel illegal migrant crossings (2018–present)|English Channel illegal migrant crossings]]
**A family of three becomes the first group sent to the [[United Kingdom]] from [[France]] under the [[United Kingdom–France one in, one out plan|one in, one out policy]] that returns unauthorized [[English Channel|Channel]] arrivals to France in exchange for vetted [[Asylum seeker|asylum-seeker]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/britain-france-migrants-small-boats-31b08e97fe22be4bf46fd3722f100343 (AP)]
*[[General debate of the eightieth session of the United Nations General Assembly]]
**[[Syria]]n [[President of Syria|president]] [[Ahmed al-Sharaa]] becomes the first Syrian leader to address the [[United Nations General Assembly]] since [[Nureddin al-Atassi]] in 1967. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-united-nations-unga-c0471a2f7faece79fe15793fb0466501 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/cjw7yy5l37no (BBC News)]
*[[Syria–Ukraine relations]]
**Syria and [[Ukraine]] restore diplomatic relations as Presidents Ahmed al-Sharaa and [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] meet on the sidelines of the [[eightieth session of the United Nations General Assembly]], following Ukraine's 2022 break in ties with Syria when the [[Presidency of Bashar al-Assad|Assad regime]] recognized [[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine|Russian-occupied territories]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-restores-diplomatic-ties-with-syria-zelenskiy-says-2025-09-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Dallas ICE facility shooting]]
**A person is killed and two others are injured in a shooting at a [[United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] facility in [[Dallas]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. The shooter is found dead on a nearby rooftop. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-09-25/-targeted-shooting-at-dallas-immigration-centre/105815636 (ABC News Australia)] [https://edition.cnn.com/us/live-news/ice-facility-dallas-shooting-09-24-25 (CNN)]
*[[Ladakh protests]]
**At least four people are killed and more than 60 others are injured as protests held by [[political demonstration|demonstrators]] demanding statehood and the inclusion of [[Ladakh]] under the [[Sixth Schedule to the Constitution of India]] turn violent in Ladakh, [[India]]. The local [[Bharatiya Janata Party]] office and a vehicle are set on fire in an [[arson]] attack. [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/protests-demanding-statehood-for-ladakh-turn-violent-bjp-office-vehicle-torched-2792622-2025-09-24 (''India Today'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Malawian general election]]
**Former [[Malawi]]an [[President of Malawi|president]] [[Peter Mutharika]] is declared the winner of the presidential election, winning 57% of votes against the incumbent [[Lazarus Chakwera]], who received 33%. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cp3wdzdwzlkt (BBC News)]
